title: Slice-determined graphs (Theorem PC+) are reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem PC+ (slice-determined, t2.md section 3 of the diameter-2 no_triple_window directory): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with u ≠ v such that every graph K on the same vertex set that (1) has, through one bijection τ, the degree and the two-walk sum (sum of neighbour degrees) of G at every vertex, (2) for every pointed card (G − r, s) with G − r − s ≅ G − u − v has as many ordered pairs (p, q) with (K − p, q) ≅ (G − r, s) as G, and (3) has as many ordered pairs (p, q) with K − p − q ≅ G − u − v as G, is isomorphic to G; is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ ∀ K : SimpleGraph (Fin n), (∃ τ : Fin n ≃ Fin n, ∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (K.neighborSet (τ x)).ncard ∧ ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator (G.neighborSet x) (fun y => ((G.neighborSet y).ncard : ℤ)) y = ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator (K.neighborSet (τ x)) (fun y => ((K.neighborSet y).ncard : ℤ)) y) → (∀ r s : Fin n, r ≠ s → Nonempty (G.induce ({r, s}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ e : K.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({r}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = s}.ncard = {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({r}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = s}.ncard) → {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ Nonempty (K.induce ({p.1, p.2}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))}.ncard = {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ Nonempty (G.induce ({p.1, p.2}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))}.ncard → Nonempty (G ≃g K))
